operations.contract: Read ordered IDs from the actual applied collection owner; do not derive output order from selection Set or a newer value snapshot.
Read first current native history entity and insert exactly one occurrence. Repeated IDs remain separate array entries; retain native handle until its last occurrence is removed.
Reverse the occurrence array before toggling/persisting future insertion direction.
Keep native input, pop one head, update shortcut state and invoke restore. Restore failure does not put the popped head back; empty queue closes session.
Queue controls shortcut registration without an accessibility precheck. Close releases content/observer and clears transient session; reopen does not load saved legacy UUID queue.

tests.trace_models: Six Python queue witnesses: duplicate retention, numeric occurrence removal, pop on failed global restore, both insertion directions/reverse, ordered selected inputs and row-paste extension failure. Not Swift/CoreData execution.
